Definition: to exchange; by implication, to change places
BiblicalUsage: Yâmar means to exchange, to take one thing in the place of another. Isaiah promises that the priests of the LORD shall eat the riches of the Gentiles and glory in their place, the shame of Israel exchanged for honour.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God is in the business of exchanges, and He trades our shame for His glory.
